query: SELECT date_trunc('day',ts) AS source_day,(array_agg(open ORDER BY ts))[1] AS session_open,max(high) AS session_high,min(low) AS session_low,(array_agg(close ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS session_close,sqrt(sum(CASE WHEN open>0 AND close>0 THEN power(ln(close/open),2) END)) AS realized_variation,bool_and(open>0 AND high>0 AND low>0 AND close>0) AS all_positive,count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_timestamps,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts FROM bars_polygon WHERE symbol=:symbol AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end AND extract(isodow from ts) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND extract(hour from ts)>=7 AND extract(hour from ts)<13 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
